result.reason: The operative language gives Company a 30-day written termination-for-convenience right covering active Statements of Work and requires return of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, substantively providing the required pro-rata refund. Contractor's right is limited to 90 days' notice when no Statement of Work is outstanding, consistent with the fallback restriction against termination during a committed engagement. The changes are targeted and preserve the broader term structure. Drafting could be improved by expressly saying “pro rata” and clarifying that Contractor's termination cannot become effective while any Statement of Work remains outstanding.
